verdict.rationale: Devin documents a permission system for MCP/tool access that can be controlled 'at multiple levels' and features like Auto-Fix, human takeover in the IDE, and interactive browser intervention imply some control over autonomous action, but there is no documented feature specifically framed as configurable 'tiered autonomy levels' for an engineering lead to set organization-wide policies on unattended agent actions. missing for 10: explicit autonomy-tier configuration UI/API, organization-wide policy controls, and confirmation-threshold settings distinct from ad-hoc MCP tool permissions.
